timeline.text: A parent wants YouTube and Spotify off, right now, no arguments.
But the kiosk already had three ways back in: a timed pass, a finished bonus quiz, a free-viewing mode.
Like a house with a master key and spare keys hidden all over it.
One button now sends a single flag through Cloudflare Workers that outranks every spare key at once.
The parent's switch finally wins over all of them — with just one tap.
